categories.main_business_segments: Altek Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in AI vision solutions, focusing on machine vision for robotics, drones, industrial automation, retail logistics, medical care, and smart agriculture. The company transitioned from a top digital camera manufacturer to a leading global AI vision solution provider, offering integrated hardware and software solutions including ISP image processing, algorithms, 3D sensing, and AI chip development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as ISP image processing, AI algorithms, 3D depth sensing, and proprietary AI chip design. Production involves integrated system development from chip design, multi-camera modules, to ODM system products. Manufacturing includes precision optical design, miniaturized camera modules, and medical device production with strict quality and regulatory compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Altek serves global customers including major semiconductor companies, smartphone manufacturers, robotics and drone producers, industrial automation firms, logistics operators, and medical device companies. Key markets include AIoT, smart manufacturing, precision medical imaging, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Asia, with significant sales in Asia (53%), Americas (28%), and Europe (19%). Manufacturing facilities are located in Taiwan (Hsinchu Science Park), Kunshan China, and Malaysia, supporting global supply chain resilience and market reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: Altek operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on IC design, module assembly, system integration, and ODM services. It collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of raw materials and components and downstream customers including brand owners and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on deepening AI vision technology innovation, integrating AI edge computing platforms, and expanding applications in robotics, unmanned devices, smart medical equipment, and AIoT. R&D investments exceed 10% of revenue, targeting next-generation disposable medical endoscopes, AI edge computing solutions, 3D sensing, and AI-powered smart injection systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of AI vision chips, camera modules, and medical imaging devices, as well as ODM/OEM system solutions. The company also engages in IP licensing and provides integrated hardware-software solutions to global customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Altek is positioned as a global leader in AI vision solutions with comprehensive capabilities from chip design to system integration. Competitors include independent algorithm developers, chip design firms, and large international brands developing proprietary AI imaging technologies. Altek maintains competitive advantage through patented deep learning algorithms, extensive chip development experience, and strong customer partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Altek reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$7.2 billion with a gross margin of 29% and net profit of NT$318 million, reflecting resilience amid global supply chain challenges. The company has a total asset base of about NT$16.9 billion and equity of NT$10.6 billion, showing steady growth and solid financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Altek offers unique value through its integrated AI vision solutions combining proprietary ISP, AI algorithms, 3D sensing, and AI chip technology. Its one-stop customized service accelerates time-to-market for clients, while its expertise in miniaturized optical design and medical device manufacturing differentiates it in precision and innovation. The company emphasizes high-performance, reliable AI vision systems tailored for robotics, smart logistics, and precision healthcare.
